Deviation or analysis decision: Review published in two articles, which the registered protocol did not anticipate: this article covers the distribution across compartments and the phenotypic proportions; molecular determinants, MIC distributions, clade, temporal variation, shared genotypes and azole exposure are deferred to the second article

Deviation or analysis decision: Full-text screening and data extraction by a language model with targeted human verification, instead of duplicate human reading
Reason: Volume of the corpus; agreement of the blind re-reading reported

Deviation or analysis decision: Language-model safety net at title and abstract screening not used; forward citation searching, thesis databases and contact with authors not used; seed-set check, checking of the reference lists of four previous reviews (instead of those of the included studies) and triangulation with PubMLST and NCBI BioSample carried out on 27 October 2026, after full-text screening
Reason: Breadth of the 20 sources searched without date or language limits; resources of the team

Deviation or analysis decision: Non-sampled full-text exclusions not re-read after the blind re-reading
Reason: Estimated effect below 0.1 points on the distribution

Deviation or analysis decision: Exclusion criteria on susceptibility data applied to the susceptibility rows only

Deviation or analysis decision: Collections defined by a deterministic rule plus team decisions on programme pairs; research group approximated by the declared institution

Deviation or analysis decision: Stratification by interpretive regime for all agents instead of the criterion version as a covariate

Deviation or analysis decision: Applicability of clinical breakpoints decided by document or version (Table S9)

Deviation or analysis decision: Rows with author-defined breakpoints excluded from the resistance analysis

Deviation or analysis decision: Disjoint subsets of a report summed when no total row was given

Deviation or analysis decision: Contrasts between strata estimated by joint models, never by subtracting estimates

Deviation or analysis decision: Bias analysis of the 1045 full-text exclusions not re-read (rate 3 of 469 from the blind sample; 1000 simulations per model and scenario; 45_qba_missed_reports_v2.R)
